title: UPPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026 – Updated
postName: Assistant Professor – Government Degree Colleges (GDC), Uttar Pradesh
vacancyDetails: Assistant Professor posts in various subjects for Government Degree Colleges under UPPSC recruitment
qualification: Master’s degree in relevant subject with NET/SET/Ph.D. or as per UGC & UPPSC GDC Assistant Professor notification
ageLimit: As per UPPSC Assistant Professor GDC advertisement (category-wise relaxations as per UP Govt rules)
selectionProcess: Written Examination / Screening → Interview → Final Result / Merit List
documentsRequired: Registration number / roll number; educational certificates, NET/Ph.D. proof, category certificate, photo ID for verification stages
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppsc.up.nic.in
2. Open Results / Download section
3. Open Assistant Professor GDC Result 2026 link
4. Download result PDF or check subject-wise merit list
5. Note interview / next stage schedule if shortlisted
shortDescription: UPPSC Assistant Professor GDC Result 2026 – check subject-wise result and merit updates on uppsc.up.nic.in.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released updates related to the Assistant Professor Government Degree College (GDC) Result 2026.

Candidates who appeared for the Assistant Professor GDC examination can check the official result / merit list subject-wise on the UPPSC portal.

What to check

  • Subject-wise result / shortlist PDF
  • Roll numbers recommended for interview (if applicable)
  • Final selection list when published

Always download the result only from uppsc.up.nic.in and keep login credentials ready for any further stages.
